title: Open call for music performances to broadcast on KAN 11 (2026)
summary: The Israeli Public Broadcasting Corporation invites holders of filming and broadcast rights to staged music performances to propose them for broadcast on KAN's platforms. Proposals must be for existing or already-planned performances, not new productions made for the broadcaster, and the performances must not depend on the broadcast to happen.
notes: Verified 2026-09-19 on KAN's own open-calls portal. DEADLINE UNKNOWN AND LEFT BLANK: the page renders as a live submission form and no closing date appeared on it — find the date in the attached submission booklet before promoting, do not infer one. ELIGIBILITY IS NARROWER THAN IT LOOKS: this addresses whoever holds the filming and broadcast rights, i.e. producers and production companies, so a solo musician generally cannot apply alone. city=jerusalem reflects the broadcaster's base, not a performance location — the call is national.

title: Eshkolot Mutual Aid Fund — hardship grants for performing artists
summary: Grants for performing artists who are members of Eshkolot and are in financial or medical hardship, awarded by the fund's aid committee under published criteria.
notes: Verified 2026-09-19 on the fund's own page. STAGED WITH A DELIBERATE WARNING RATHER THAN RECOMMENDED FOR PROMOTION. Two reasons. (1) Eligibility is closed, not open: only Eshkolot members with a royalty history qualify (10/3/5-year average not below 700 ILS, or cumulative royalties above 30,000 ILS); non-members cannot apply at all. (2) It is a hardship fund conditioned on demonstrated financial or medical distress, not an opportunity an artist pursues for their practice. Listing it beside residencies and commissions may misrepresent what it is, and would surface a dead end to most users. Rolling, no deadline. The owner should decide whether Fellow. carries welfare instruments at all.

title: Jerusalem Print Residency (רזידנסי הדפס ירושלמי)
summary: Bezalel Academy and the Jerusalem Print Workshop host three Jerusalem-based creators at the print workshop for three months, training with the workshop's printers and mentored by its director and chief curator Dr Tamar Gispan-Greenberg. Participants produce a limited-edition series of prints, one copy of which enters the workshop's collection, and the residency closes with an exhibition at the workshop and on the Bezalel campus.
notes: Verified 2026-09-19 on bezalel.ac.il. ALMOST CERTAINLY CLOSED: published 22.3.26 for a residency running July-October 2026, which is already under way as of today. Deadline left blank because the closing date was not on the portion of the page read — do not infer one. Eligibility is tightly drawn: creators LIVING IN JERUSALEM who graduated from a Jerusalem art or design school within the last three years. Staged so the programme is on file for its next cycle, not for promotion now.

title: Hora Jerusalem — call for dance teachers
summary: Hora Jerusalem is recruiting dance teachers across a range of styles to join its teaching staff, training dancers of all ages from early childhood through to adult dancers.
notes: Verified 2026-09-19 by reading the Instagram post. THIS IS A JOB, NOT AN ARTISTIC COMMISSION — typed as audition_job so it is not presented alongside residencies and grants as if it were one. Posted 5 May 2026, so the positions may well be filled; no deadline was given. CV to info@horajerusalem.org or WhatsApp 02-6785036. No salary stated, so funding fields are empty rather than assumed.

title: Otzrot Tarbut — call for artists, producers and cultural institutions (אוצרותרבות)
summary: The Ministry of Culture and Sport is building a national digital database of quality cultural events that local authorities book from, across six fields: music, theatre and fringe, dance, cinema, literature, and visual art and museums. The call seeks professional, high-quality performances that meet the threshold conditions and are assessed by professional quality committees in each field.
notes: Verified 2026-09-19 on gov.il, which marks it STATUS: פעיל (ACTIVE), published 19.07.2026. THE BROADEST-REACH ISRAELI OPPORTUNITY FOUND TO DATE — national, currently active, and it names DANCE and MUSIC explicitly, which is the product's priority focus. Eligible: cultural bodies and institutions, NGOs, companies, licensed dealers, ensembles, creators, performers, producers and content suppliers meeting the threshold conditions. Deadline left blank: it reads as a standing database submission with no closing date published, but the attached official call document was not opened — check it before promoting. city=jerusalem reflects the ministry, not a venue; this is national in reach.
